what: The Armada campaign map's European building atlas (Tudor and Habsburg coastal forts, half-timbered towns, flags of England and Spain) and the theatre's relief (Britain, Ireland, the Channel and the Low Countries).

atlas.prompts: src/ui/grand/buildingAtlas.json factions.england, each prompt followed by its style line
atlas.costNote: Estimate (~0.17 USD per high-quality 1024x1024 image); 19 cells and flags, one (door) generated again after a network failure. The script does not log usage.

relief.tool: scripts/fetch-dem.mjs --region=britain (Terrarium elevation tiles, zoom 8, AWS open data: Mapzen / USGS / NOAA and others), then scripts/build-grand-terrain.mjs --theatre=armada
